title: Bug: [T2] Regression in test_show_platform.py due to fixture change
author: Javier-Tan
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

PR #22890 changed the fixtures used to pick test dut from `duthost = duthosts[enum_supervisor_dut_hostname]` to `duthost = duthosts[rand_one_dut_hostname]` for certain tests.

This is a regression for T2 chassis as we only support `show platform psustatus` and `show platform fan` on the supervisor for T2 chassis.

### Steps to Reproduce

Run `test_show_platform.py::test_show_platform_psustatus` and `test_show_platform.py::test_show_platform_fan` on T2 chassis, see that it fails more often than not.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

`test_show_platform_psustatus`, `test_show_platform_psustatus_json` and `test_show_platform_fan` should only run on supervisor for T2 chassis.

### Relevant log output

```shell
admin@sonic-lc:~$ show platform fan
Fan Not detected
admin@sonic-lc:~$ show platform psustatus
PSU    Model    Serial    HW Rev    Voltage (V)    Current (A)    Power (W)    Status    LED
-----  -------  --------  --------  -------------  -------------  -----------  --------  -----
```

### Output of `show version`

```shell
N/A
```

### Attach files (if any)

_No response_
